capabilities: Create timestamped journal entries as ordinary Markdown files
Scroll and edit a continuous newest-first timeline inline
Filter the timeline by tag or search entry text
Show journal entries that mention a linked note
Refile, rename, or re-date existing entries after changing settings
extras: Uses an undocumented internal API (app.embedRegistry.embedByExtension) for inline editors, with feature detection and a textarea fallback; the empirical contract is documented in docs/editor-embed-api.md. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's daily-notes model gives one titled note per day, with no way to keep many short, titleless entries per day and read or edit them as one continuous timeline.
summary: Entry-based journal where each entry is one timestamped Markdown note, shown and edited inline in a continuous newest-first timeline.
